overheat.label: Arcane Overheat
overheat.reminder: When a mage casts magic, the Spell Intensity they choose equals the amount of Arcane Overheat that builds up within them. A higher Arcane Overheat results in increasing penalties.
overheat.smolderingWithRangeReminder:
Smoldering (%s):
  • Ob for magic tests always increased by +1 and Spell-Backfire on less than 2 hits.
overheat.broilingWithRangeReminder:
Broiling (%s):
  • Ob for magic tests always increased by +2 and Spell-Backfire on less than 3 hits.
  • For all other tests, -1D
overheat.consumingWithRangeReminder:
Consuming (%s):
  • 1D8 + 2 Pure damage every Tick
  • Every further attempt to cast a spell instantly fails
  • For all other tests, -2D

slag.label: Arcane Slag
slag.reminder:
When a mage casts magic, one third (RD and minimum 1) of the Spell Intensity they choose equals the amount of Arcane Slag that builds up within them. The other two thirds turn into Arcane Overheat.
1 point of Arcane Slag automatically leaves the character's body, every 6 hours. If that time is spent in active rest or meditation - that means doing nothing besides rest -, then 2 points leave the body, instead.
